## New Features

**Agent: E2B Sandbox, Home Snapshots, and Skill Management**
- **E2B sandbox backend**: agent shell/code execution can now run on [E2B](https://e2b.dev) cloud sandboxes in addition to the local sandbox. items.name: ollama/ollama v0.40.14
items.description:
## What's Changed
* `ollama launch claude` now applies the model's output token limit for Claude Code, so cloud models no longer run into the 128k default cap
* Cloud web search responses on `/api/chat` are now decoded correctly, including compressed responses
* OpenAI-compatible endpoints no longer override a model's packaged sampler defaults — clients that send no `temperature`/`top_p` get the model's own values instead of 1.0, matching `/api/chat`
* `/v1/responses` now preserves readable

items.name: ollama/ollama v0.40.13
items.description:
## LFM3 on Linux and Windows

Liquid AI's [LFM3](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3) models, including text-to-speech in [lfm3-audio](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-audio) and [lfm3-omni](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-omni), now run on Linux and Windows as well as Apple silicon.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.12...v0.40.13

items.name: vercel/next.js v16.5.0-canary.40
items.description:
### Core Changes

- Add instrumentationInject for adapter-supplied instrumentation: #100658
- test(codemod): fix flaky agents-md e2e cascade on slow GitHub clones: #101122
- perf(build): use nft's cached readlink when collecting build traces: #99678
- [experiment] support App Router route.go handlers: #100130

### Misc Changes

- server actions: read cache kinds lazily: #101071
- turbo-tasks-backend: fix lost idle wakeup in the snapshot loop: #100290
- eval: clarify React transitions and prefetc

items.name: vercel/next.js v16.5.0-canary.39
items.description:
### Core Changes

- Strip internal middleware cookie headers from edge responses: #101109
- Fix stale compressed framing for forwarded fetch responses: #101108
- [use cache] Fix cache key when binary args are used: #101107
- Fix shared shell poisoning from request-supplied placeholder params: #101106
- [next/image] Fix false-positive AVIF/HEIC detection: #101105
- Fix `unstable_cache` leaking cold `'use cache'` fills across root params: #101104
- Fix outer 'use cache' entries reused across root

items.name: vercel/next.js v16.5.0-canary.38
items.description:
### Core Changes

- Fix blocking revalidation for `fetch` and `unstable_cache`: #101077

### Misc Changes

- Turbopack: avoid invalidating per-module analysis when the encryption key changes: #100950
- turbo-tasks: add cancelable cell reads via Vc::lazy_reader(): #101008
- Turbopack: use simd-utf16-len for source position column counting: #100973
- Fix layout client chunk leakage across async server imports: #101040
- Pin Tailwind to 4.3.3 in create-next-app: #101061
